notes.title: Slice the Ice is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Slice the Ice is coming to Steam![/h1]

Finally!! My mobile game, already available for Android and iOS, is coming to Steam early in December: 

[url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/750740/Slice_the_Ice/[/url]

Until then check out this cute physics puzzler for Android devices and iPhone/iPad:

[url]https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fancyfactory.slicetheice[/url]
[url]https://itunes.apple.com/app/slice-the-ice/id372344620?mt=8[/url]

I really hope you will like it! :)

Regards, Axel
